text: Eli Lilly secures Kelonia Therapeutics through milestone-based acquisition structure. Capital concentrates on in vivo CAR-T platform while aligning internal pipeline beyond GLP-1 concentration. Access pathways broaden from specialized ex vivo systems toward generalized delivery model.

meta.note: Expansion and compression co-present; dominance assigned to capital concentration over access broadening.

text: Kevin Warsh defines operational limits for Federal Reserve while external political pressure and internal scrutiny coexist. Authority claims diverge across monetary policy, governance oversight, and nomination process, with independence framed against boundary restriction.

meta.note: Legitimacy and containment overlap; containment selected for explicit boundary enforcement language.
